Previous five-bank spectrum {4,2,1} completion-defect family is now controlled for all admissible product laws by ||p||inf<=2pi and has continuous density, removing the prior Gaussian-only restriction.
Direct partner-r29 grouped two-slope lift: ||p_(2Y1Y3+2Y2Y4+R)||inf<=4(s1s2s3s4)^(-1/2) on four disjoint original-coordinate banks.
Target-valid diffuse family with bank-level spectrum {1,1,1,-1,-1} and physical coefficients 1/m has continuous density <=4 for every admissible product law.
